text:
Diane (net-arch): post-RFC sync: we need a low-risk cutover for private endpoints (v1 -> v2) that avoids double-egress and minimizes src-ip churn for NAT customers.
Owen (infra): +1. ops constraint: some customers have ACLs bound to source IPs. what's our minimal continuity promise?
Diane (net-arch): we can offer a session-affinity window backed by signed affinity tokens (default 2m). plan: short dual-advertise, token-based affinity, per-tenant migration flag.
Masao (onboarding): can we surface a tenant API toggle plus a CLI opt-out? also need a dry-run mode for SEs.
Diane (net-arch): API: PATCH /tenants/:id {migration_mode: canary|force|hold}. dry-run toggles simulate handshakes (no DNS changes).
Priya (eng-sre): metrics we need: cp_migration_v2_attempts_total, cp_migration_v2_handshake_latency_ms (histogram), cp_migration_v2_fallbacks_total, cp_affinity_cache_misses. alert if >0.7% tenants in fallback for 10m.
Ruth (product): docs one-liner: "No planned downtime; persistent TCP sessions may see short-lived IP continuity changes. Contact SE for strict ACLs." also include a migration FAQ and billing note.
Owen (infra): token details: v2 uses short-lived signed route tokens (TTL=6m). tokens require clock sync and a refresh path. options: relay-agent or ship a tiny renewer for on-prem.
Masao (onboarding): we'll build a static token-renewer binary (~1.5MB) with /health and a socket write for the local stack. supports --dry-run and --simulate-refresh flags.
Diane (net-arch): affinity token format: tenant_id|route_hash|issued_at|ttl|hmac. default ttl=120s. edge honors valid affinity tokens to keep established flows on the same path.
Priya (eng-sre): prefer enforcing affinity via token verification rather than RIB-level pinning to avoid route thrash. add a fallback counter if token validation fails.
Owen (infra): DNS approach: apex TTL=30s, helper-record TTL=600s, dual-push duration 7 minutes. sequence: enable canary, dual-push, monitor, promote.
Masao (onboarding): CLI helpers: rctl tenant migrate --id TID --mode canary --pilot-size 3 --dry-run. also an immediate opt-out: rctl tenant migrate --id TID --mode hold.
deploy-bot: deploy started: token-renewer v0.1 -> staging (sha: aa11bb)
Diane (net-arch): runbook (brief): 1) set migration_mode=canary 2) deploy renewer or ensure relay 3) dual-push DNS 4) monitor metrics and fallback rate 5) promote or rollback. rollback = set migration_mode=hold + purge affinity cache.
Priya (eng-sre): I'll prototype alert rules and a small synthetic that exercises handshake -> token refresh -> affinity. also add grafana panels for fallback rate by tenant.
Ruth (product): I'll prepare the email template and FAQ with the exact one-liner and an opt-out contact flow.
Owen (infra): follow-ups: implement clock-skew checks in renewer and a health indicator if skew >30s. document for on-prem installs.
Diane (net-arch): I'll draft an RFC addendum with sequence diagrams and an affinity token validation flow. will tag reviewers when ready. :thumbsup:
